name: ascii-wallpaper-collection
description: 93 live ASCII-tile wallpapers for Claude Code in Claude Desktop, in nine modes (Focus, Chill, Nature, Space, Energy, Dev, Creatures, Art, Minimal): thumbnail picker, scenes that react to your commands, matching themes, light and dark, your handle signed in.

name.title: Your handle
name.description: Signed into the scenes: the ~/name prompt in a corner, the title block on Blueprint, the prompt on Night Shift. Letters, digits . _ - only, 16 at most.
